read: The board is mostly range-bound with BTC in a mild risk-off regime; the largest imbalances sit in the weak tails (WLD, LIT) and in HL-local funding premiums.

watchlist.note: WLD is -20.01 vs BTC over 7d with a 1d rangePos of 0.06 and 1.47 ATR under the 1d SMA20; HL funding reads 10.95 against -0.11 on CEX, so risk skews to a squeeze if the 4h stops falling.
LIT trends down on 4h and 1d, is -10.92 vs BTC over 7d, and HL funding is 21.45 points over CEX at 10.95 versus -10.5, so the crowding is local to HL; we lean toward continuation, low-confidence.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back under the 4h SMA20 after a bounce, with a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: kPEPE is +9.71 vs BTC over 24h and 2.5 ATR over the 4h SMA20 with its 7d funding percentile at 98, though funding matches CEX at 0 points; the base case is a fade only if the 4h sweeps its high.

brief: Delta since the last run: XMR-long was cancelled after HL funding moved to 43.83, which broke its neutral-funding premise. Open book is ZEC long, ENA short and DOGE short, all triggered, none closed. The one tripwire hit (DOGE htf_pullback short) is the setup already open, so no new plans this run. Watchlist leans on WLD and LIT weakness and kPEPE crowding.
